findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quote_laser_file, get_order_status, request_custom_quote, get_proof_image · Private data: quote_laser_file, create_order, request_custom_quote, list_templates, quote_order, quote_reorder, create_reorder, find_order · Public sink: quote_laser_file, create_order, get_order_status, request_custom_quote, quote_order, get_proof_image, quote_reorder, request_order_change, find_order · Destructive: request_custom_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quote_laser_file, get_order_status, request_custom_quote, get_proof_image · Private data: quote_laser_file, create_order, request_custom_quote, list_templates, quote_order, quote_reorder, create_reorder, find_order · Public sink: quote_laser_file, create_order, get_order_status, request_custom_quote, quote_order, get_proof_image, quote_reorder, request_order_change, find_order · Destructive: request_custom_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
